blocks.content: The analysis of linear models relies very heavily on sums of squares, which can be expressed in matrix notation as quadratic forms. To introduce the reader to the machinery used to work with sums of squares, we first present expressions for the mean and variance of a quadratic form, and then express linear model sums of squares as quadratic forms.
